strings.zh: 奇怪？听不大清楚,{NEWLINE}电话坏了么？{SCROLL}你换个地方再打试试！
strings.en: Huh? I can’t hear you very well.{NEWLINE}We must have a bad connection.{SCROLL}Try calling again from somewhere else!

strings.zh: 喂喂⋯⋯{NEWLINE}怎么了？你怎么了？{CLEAR}你不用担心我,{CLEAR}我健康得很。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello...{NEWLINE}What’s up? What’s wrong?{SCROLL}No need to worry about me.{NEWLINE}I’m as healthy as they come!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 如果觉得无聊,{NEWLINE}就去全国各地挑战道馆吧。{CLEAR}整个地区可是有16个道馆呢。
strings.en: If you’re bored, go challenge Gyms{NEWLINE}all over the land. There are 16 Gyms{CLEAR}across the whole region, you know.

strings.zh: 我在星期二的白天{NEWLINE}没有什么活可做,{CLEAR}要是你愿意的话,{CLEAR}到时候可以打电话找我！
strings.en: I don’t do anything at all around noon{NEWLINE}on Tuesdays. You should give me a call{CLEAR}then sometime if you’re free.

strings.zh: 哦！{SCROLL}你电话来得真是时候！{NEWLINE}和我再对战一次吧！{CLEAR}行吧？行吧？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Whoa-ho!{SCROLL}You called at just the right{NEWLINE}time! Battle me again! How{CLEAR}about it? How about it? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 哦！{SCROLL}谢谢！{NEWLINE}我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你！
strings.en: Whoa-ho!{SCROLL}Thanks! I’ll be waiting for you at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle Frontier!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 难得你有心情{NEWLINE}想和我来场较量,{CLEAR}可是你还有其他人的{CLEAR}预约没有完成啊。
strings.en: Look, I appreciate that you want to{NEWLINE}battle me again, but didn’t you already{CLEAR}make plans with somebody else?

strings.zh: 我在战斗前线的训练家屋等你。{CLEAR}哦！
strings.en: I’ll be waiting for you at the Trainer{NEWLINE}House at the Battle Frontier. Whoa-ho!
strings.notes: Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 我是夏伯,{NEWLINE}你最近怎么样？{SCROLL}
我们不是约好了{NEWLINE}在战斗前线的训练家屋战斗的吗？{CLEAR}我一直都在等你啊！
strings.en: We agreed to battle at the{NEWLINE}Trainer House at the Battle{CLEAR}Frontier, didn’t we? I’ve been{CLEAR}waiting for you all this time!
strings.notes: US 0651/11 | Rematch venue: the hack changed the US Fighting Dojo in Saffron City to 战斗前线的训练家屋 → the Trainer House at the Battle Frontier.

strings.zh: 红莲岛一直笼罩在{NEWLINE}被火山爆发吞噬的危机中,{CLEAR}即使这样岛上的居民{CLEAR}都没有离开自己的家乡。{SCROLL}安土重迁只有四个字,{NEWLINE}但里面的感情却是很深很深的。
strings.en: Cinnabar Island has always lived under{NEWLINE}the threat of being swallowed by an{CLEAR}eruption, and yet not one islander ever{CLEAR}left their home.{SCROLL}Love of one’s homeland is easy to put{NEWLINE}into words, but the feeling behind it{CLEAR}runs very, very deep.
strings.notes: | RV071: omission: threat of being swallowed by an eruption restored

strings.zh: 当我说要把红莲道馆{NEWLINE}藏起来的时候,{CLEAR}得到了岛上训练家们的支持。{CLEAR}大家能答应我这个任性的决定{CLEAR}真是让我非常感动⋯⋯
strings.en: When I said I wanted to hide the{NEWLINE}Cinnabar Gym away, the island’s{CLEAR}Trainers backed me. It truly{CLEAR}moved me that everyone went{CLEAR}along with my selfish decision...

strings.zh: 我奋斗一生却无儿无女,{NEWLINE}每天跟小爱的猜谜游戏{CLEAR}让我体验到了{CLEAR}不曾有过的天伦之乐。{SCROLL}唔……不说了,{NEWLINE}感觉眼泪要出来了。
strings.en: I’ve fought my whole life and never{NEWLINE}had children of my own. My daily quiz{CLEAR}games with Amber gave me a taste of{CLEAR}family happiness I’d never known.{SCROLL}Mm... I’ll stop there. I{NEWLINE}feel the tears coming.
